relationships.note: Five days apart he applies two incompatible standards to his own record. On the Australia drought: if it is not happening, call it an off-word. On the decamillionaire word: the objection that it was a misword is raised by him and refused. Which standard applies appears to track the subject matter.
Same country a month apart with opposite tone: much darkness in December, a liberation day in January. He does not join them.
Within three weeks the return is both nearer than anyone realises and further out than the audience hopes, with a work to be done first.
He rejects hinting for support on 5 January and addresses the promised return to those who sowed sacrificially on 8 January.
Two places where he directs the audience away from himself, to a local church and off the platform.
